title: Conductor type (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. A conductor (phase conductor or earth wire) as a catalogue item, pointed at by spans and earth wires. Carried beside the model, never used by the solver: a line's r, x and b stay the authored per-unit values.

code.description: The catalogue or code name (for example Zebra).

dcResistanceOhmPerKm.description: DC resistance at 20 degC, ohms per kilometre.
